# Real Python

> Comprehensive Python learning platform with expert tutorials, interactive courses, and AI-powered tools for developers of all skill levels.

Real Python provides structured learning paths, interactive quizzes, and a supportive community for Python education. The platform offers membership access to video courses, live office hours, and a weekly podcast hosted by Christopher Bailey, along with an AI-powered Code Mentor tool for personalized learning support.

## Key Topics

- Python fundamentals
- FastAPI
- Django
- Flask
- Career development
- Skill-building
- Best practices
- Python 3
- CPython
- Learning paths
- Web development
- AI-assisted coding
- Interview preparation
- Community support
- Programming tips

## Getting Started

- [Become a Python Expert – Real Python](https://realpython.com/start-here): Complete learning system with expert tutorials, courses, quizzes to level up Python skills.
- [Python Basics – Real Python](https://realpython.com/tutorials/basics): Beginner-friendly tutorials covering Python fundamentals, variables, loops, and functions.
- [Python Learning Paths – Real Python](https://realpython.com/learning-paths): Structured learning roadmaps for beginner, intermediate, and advanced Python developers.
- [Build Your Weekly Python Study Schedule – Real Python](https://realpython.com/weekly-study-schedule): Guide to creating a sustainable 7-day Python learning schedule with time management tips.

## Courses & Learning Resources

- [Membership – Real Python](https://realpython.com/account/join): Real Python membership plans offering course access, community features, and video lessons.
- [Python Books by Real Python – Real Python](https://realpython.com/products/books): Real Python books including Python Basics and CPython Internals for skill development.
- [Python Quizzes – Real Python](https://realpython.com/quizzes): Interactive Python quizzes for skill assessment across FastAPI, web scraping, and more.
- [All Python Tutorial Topics – Real Python](https://realpython.com/tutorials/all): Directory of Python tutorials organized by topic and skill level.
- [Code Mentor: Intelligent Learning Tools – Real Python](https://realpython.com/mentor): AI-powered Code Mentor tool for instant code explanations, reviews, and personalized learning.

## Specialized Topics

- [Python Career – Real Python](https://realpython.com/tutorials/career): Interview prep with coding challenges, data structures, and portfolio building guidance.
- [Python Coding With AI – Real Python](https://realpython.com/tutorials/ai): Tutorials on AI-assisted Python development, LLMs, FastAPI, and RAG implementations.
- [Reference – Real Python](https://realpython.com/ref): Python reference guide covering built-in functions, standard library, and best practices.

## Community & Support

- [Office Hours – Real Python](https://realpython.com/office-hours): Members-only live Q&A sessions with Real Python team for personalized learning support.
- [Join the Real Python Community Chat – Real Python](https://realpython.com/community): Real Python Slack community for members to discuss Python and career development.
- [The Real Python Podcast – Real Python](https://realpython.com/podcasts/rpp): Weekly Python podcast with interviews, tips, and community conversations hosted by Christopher Bailey.
- [The Real Python Newsletter – Real Python](https://realpython.com/newsletter): Free weekly Python newsletter with programming tips and career development advice.

## Inspiration & Stories

- [Learner Stories – Real Python](https://realpython.com/learner-stories): Success stories of Pythonistas who leveled up skills and careers with Real Python.
